content.title: THE MINERAL {{YOUR THYROID}} IS BEGGING YOU FOR
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Cod | Seaweed | Dairy Milk | Eggs
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Cashews | Shiitake Mushrooms | Lentils | Dark Chocolate
**Potassium** (Blood Pressure Balancer) — Sweet Potato | Coconut Water | White Beans | Bananas
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Pineapple | Brown Rice | Chickpeas | Pecans
**Selenium** (Antioxidant Shield) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Sunflower Seeds | Brown Rice
**Calcium** (Nerve Signal Sender) — Sardines | Tahini | Bok Choy | Almonds
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your thyroid runs almost entirely on iodine, and most people don't think about it until something feels off — low energy, cold hands, slow metabolism. Just a couple servings of cod or a sprinkle of seaweed a week can cover what your thyroid needs to keep producing its hormones properly. Copper works quietly in the background too — it helps your body actually absorb and use the iron you already eat, so without enough copper, even an iron-rich diet can fall short. And potassium is the one most people only associate with bananas, but it's really working inside every cell to balance sodium and keep your blood pressure from creeping up. Everyone's body is different, so listen to yours.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health symptoms, your organs, and the small daily habits that tie it all together. Our goal is simple: help you understand your body instead of guessing with trends.
